title: Teddy And Peddy Went Into Jungle

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Teddy, wake up! We are going on a *safari* today! {jump}

segments.say: Teddy, wake up! We are going on a *safari* today!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Safari? Can we ride a wild *tiger* instead of walking? {sleep}

segments.say: Safari? Can we ride a wild *tiger* instead of walking?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: No tigers! Just a quiet *jungle* walk! {angry}

segments.say: No tigers! Just a quiet *jungle* walk!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} A jungle? But my *shoes* have white laces! {sad}

segments.say: A jungle? But my *shoes* have white laces!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Who cares about shoes? Grab a *stick*! {laugh}

segments.say: Who cares about shoes? Grab a *stick*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} A stick? For what? To fight *monsters*? {gasp}

segments.say: A stick? For what? To fight *monsters*?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Just in case we meet a hungry *bear*! {shake-head}

segments.say: Just in case we meet a hungry *bear*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {ohoo} A bear?! {scared} I am calling *cancellation* right now! {phone}

segments.say: A bear?!
I am calling *cancellation* right now!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Stop joking and start *walking*! {angry}

segments.say: Stop joking and start *walking*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: Fine, but if a monkey steals my *banana*, you pay! {nod}

segments.say: Fine, but if a monkey steals my *banana*, you pay!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Look, Teddy! The *entrance* to the jungle is right here! {point}

segments.say: Look, Teddy! The *entrance* to the jungle is right here!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} It looks more like a spooky *bush* to me. {shaking}

segments.say: It looks more like a spooky *bush* to me.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Don't be a *chicken*! Step inside! {laugh}

segments.say: Don't be a *chicken*! Step inside!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {oops} My foot caught a *root*! I am falling! {fall}

segments.say: My foot caught a *root*! I am falling!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {aah} You fell before we even *started*! {facepalm}

segments.say: You fell before we even *started*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} That root was *personal*. It attacked my toe! {angry}

segments.say: That root was *personal*. It attacked my toe!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Get up! The *adventure* awaits us! {jump}

segments.say: Get up! The *adventure* awaits us!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: My adventure is already *ruined* by dirt. {sad}

segments.say: My adventure is already *ruined* by dirt.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Stop crying and look at those giant *trees*! {wow}

segments.say: Stop crying and look at those giant *trees*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} They look like green *broccoli*. I want lunch. {eat}

segments.say: They look like green *broccoli*. I want lunch.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Stay close to me. We might find *treasure* here! {whisper}

segments.say: Stay close to me. We might find *treasure* here!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Or we might find a wild *boar* with no manners! {scared}

segments.say: Or we might find a wild *boar* with no manners!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Relax! There are no boars, only *birds* singing. {nod}

segments.say: Relax! There are no boars, only *birds* singing.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} Listen! What is that scary *sound*? {shock}

segments.say: Listen! What is that scary *sound*?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Sound? I don't hear *anything*. {look-around}

segments.say: Sound? I don't hear *anything*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: It sounded like a giant *monster* chewing metal! {scared}

segments.say: It sounded like a giant *monster* chewing metal!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Oh, that's just my empty *lunchbox* rattling in my bag. {laugh}

segments.say: Oh, that's just my empty *lunchbox* rattling in my bag.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} You scared my *soul* out of my body! {angry}

segments.say: You scared my *soul* out of my body!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Sorry! Let's keep moving down this *path*. {peace}

segments.say: Sorry! Let's keep moving down this *path*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: I am walking like a *penguin* because of the mud. {sad}

segments.say: I am walking like a *penguin* because of the mud.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Penguins are cool! Just pretend you're in a *movie*. {yay}

segments.say: Penguins are cool! Just pretend you're in a *movie*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Wait. Where did the *path* go? {look-around}

segments.say: Wait. Where did the *path* go?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Um... I think we took a wrong *turn*. {sweat}

segments.say: Um... I think we took a wrong *turn*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: You think?! We are completely *lost* in the wild! {shout}

segments.say: You think?! We are completely *lost* in the wild!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Don't panic! We just need to follow the *sun*. {nod}

segments.say: Don't panic! We just need to follow the *sun*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: The sun is right above our heads, it has no *map*! {facepalm}

segments.say: The sun is right above our heads, it has no *map*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Look up there! Is that a giant *monkey*? {point}

segments.say: Look up there! Is that a giant *monkey*?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} It's not a monkey, it's a wild *gorilla*! {scared}

segments.say: It's not a monkey, it's a wild *gorilla*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Quick, pretend we are *statues*! Don't move! {whisper}

segments.say: Quick, pretend we are *statues*! Don't move!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: I am already shaking like a *jelly*! {sweat}

segments.say: I am already shaking like a *jelly*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} The gorilla is looking right at your shiny *shoes*. {suspicious}

segments.say: The gorilla is looking right at your shiny *shoes*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: Is it *gone* yet? My legs are freezing! {cry}

segments.say: Is it *gone* yet? My legs are freezing!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} It wasn't a gorilla. It was a funny *tree* stump! {laugh}

segments.say: It wasn't a gorilla. It was a funny *tree* stump!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: A tree stump?! You nearly gave me a *heart* attack! {angry}

segments.say: A tree stump?! You nearly gave me a *heart* attack!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: But it was a very realistic *stump*, admit it! {grin}

segments.say: But it was a very realistic *stump*, admit it!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: I am never trusting your *navigation* skills again! {shake-head}

segments.say: I am never trusting your *navigation* skills again!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Look on the bright side, we found a wild *stream*! {wow}

segments.say: Look on the bright side, we found a wild *stream*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: Can we drink from it? I am so *thirsty*! {drink}

segments.say: Can we drink from it? I am so *thirsty*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Wait! That water looks a bit *muddy* and green. {suspicious}

segments.say: Wait! That water looks a bit *muddy* and green.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: Too late, I already took a big *gulp*! {cough}

segments.say: Too late, I already took a big *gulp*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Oh no! That's not a stream, that's a frog *pool*! {shock}

segments.say: Oh no! That's not a stream, that's a frog *pool*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: My stomach is making funny *frog* noises now. {sad}

segments.say: My stomach is making funny *frog* noises now.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: That means you have extra *energy* for walking! {laugh}

segments.say: That means you have extra *energy* for walking!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: I want to go *home* to my warm bed immediately! {cry}

segments.say: I want to go *home* to my warm bed immediately!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: But we haven't found the secret jungle *cave* yet! {point}

segments.say: But we haven't found the secret jungle *cave* yet!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: I don't care about caves! I want *pizza*! {shout}

segments.say: I don't care about caves! I want *pizza*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Fine, let's follow this *river* back to town. {nod}

segments.say: Fine, let's follow this *river* back to town.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: If we see another tree stump, I am *punching* it. {angry}

segments.say: If we see another tree stump, I am *punching* it.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Deal! Just watch out for that sneaky *vine*! {warning}

segments.say: Deal! Just watch out for that sneaky *vine*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: What vine? I don't see any— *whoa*! {trip}

segments.say: What vine? I don't see any— *whoa*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} And down he goes into the *bush*! {laugh}

segments.say: And down he goes into the *bush*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} Never again. Jungle trips are a total *scam*. {facepalm}

segments.say: Never again. Jungle trips are a total *scam*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Come on, it was a great *adventure* for us! {yay}

segments.say: Come on, it was a great *adventure* for us!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: My shoes are ruined, my tummy hurts, I'm *muddy*. {cry}

segments.say: My shoes are ruined, my tummy hurts, I'm *muddy*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: But look! You brought home a souvenir *leaf*! {point}

segments.say: But look! You brought home a souvenir *leaf*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: This leaf has a caterpillar eating it *alive*. {scared}

segments.say: This leaf has a caterpillar eating it *alive*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: See? Even the insects have more *fun* than you! {laugh}

segments.say: See? Even the insects have more *fun* than you!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: Next time you say safari, I am locking the *door*. {angry}

segments.say: Next time you say safari, I am locking the *door*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Next time we bring extra *snacks*, I promise! {nod}

segments.say: Next time we bring extra *snacks*, I promise!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: There is definitely no *next* time, Peddy! {shake-head}

segments.say: There is definitely no *next* time, Peddy!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Okay, okay! Movie night at my place instead! {yay}

segments.say: Okay, okay! Movie night at my place instead!
